answer: Geographic-mesa seating: a seat is minted only when five independent vantage points time a lantern probe to the applicant and their round-trip vectors agree on one region inside 300 km. Each mesa (one agreed region) holds at most two seats, and every vector carries the vantage's own signed clock, so one machine cannot forge five agreeing timings. Reaching k seats means renting k/2 separate regions, whose local prices rise as supply thins; a single forged vector voids that batch's bond. Marginal cost climbs with regional breadth, never with API keys.
